rows.abstract: "Kindergarten Act of 1998". Mandates the government to provide the necessary funding for a national kidnergarten program --- preschool level or one year of schooling before Grade I, which shall be FREE and COMPULSORY for all five-year old citizens.
rows.status: Substituted by HB11692

rows.author: C113
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A PERIODIC REVIEW OF THE ECONOMY, EFFICIENCY AND VIABILITY OF GOVERNMENT-OWNE D AND -OR -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS BY CONGRESS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.abstract: Proposes to grant nontax incentives to CBEs by the government, such as: (1) access to credit capitalization; (2) technical training support; and (3) marketing assistance.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08336

rows.author: C113
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ALLOCATE 20% OF THE REGISTRATION FEES OF MOTOR VEHICLES TO LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS
rows.abstract: States that collection from registration fees of motor vehicles shall be APPORTIONED to both the national government and the local government units in an 80-20 ratio.

rows.abstract: Proposes to ALLOW bar examination flunkers, as well as board examination flunkers, who failed in one (1) to two (2) sybjects to RETAKE ONLY the subject or subjects where the examinee failed.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07572

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C113
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZ ING SKILLS TRAINING AND RE-TRAINING
rows.abstract: "Skills Training and Retraining Act".  Seeks to provide adequate and relevant skills training and retraining program, as well as to update standard skills and introduce new crafts for employment and re-employment of workers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-28

rows.abstract: "Safeguard Measures Act of 1998". Provides safeguard measures necessary to protect local industries as a result of the increased importation of any article based on the tariff concessions made under the World Trade Organization.

RETURNS to the Department of Health all health services and facilities that were devolved to the local government units under RA 7160 to further prevent its deterioration;provide essential health services to the people ; improve and uplift the morale, social and economic well-being of devolved health workers; and develop a professional health manpower that is responsive to the people's health needs and problems.
rows.status: Consigned to the Archives on 1999-01-26

rows.abstract: "The Department of Fisheries and Oceans Act of 1998". Declares it a policy of the State to accelerate and promote the integrated development of the fishery industry and to keep the fishery resources of the country in optimum productive condition through proper utilization, conservation and protection.

rows.abstract: Enables the medical practitioners to pursue their vow to treat those in need regardless of class, creed or ideology, thus, eliminating their apprehension and hesitation on the risk that they might be implicated in the course of the performance of their duties.
